gdb.method: apt-get download followed by dpkg-deb -x into a fresh scratch root; no installation/postinst

original_unit_suite.scope_note: The original 14-test upstream set was compiled before subsequent parent edits that add build-lock regression tests. Those later tests are outside this binary/evidence.

non_vm_integration_subset.selection_basis: Read test source first; exclude all cases that call run/test or start QEMU. Direct test harness execution from scratch avoids generated project files in source.

daemon_diagnostics.diagnostic_limit: Numeric /proc/<namespace_pid> is not a reliable predicate here. Focused passes do not establish that descendant supervision is correct.
daemon_diagnostics.production_risk_open: Supervisor waits for the direct leader; kill/terminate skip once leader is reaped, so a TERM-ignoring descendant may remain. Not resolved or tested by these ordinary sleep diagnostics.
